### Kolmogorov's Maximal Inequality for Sums

:::{.theorem data-title="Kolmogorov's Maximal Inequality for Sums"}

Let $S_{n}= \xi_{1}+\dots + \xi_{n}$ for independent $\xi_{i}$s with
$\mathbb{E}\xi_{i}^2<\infty$. Then for $\lambda>0$
$$
\mathbb{P}\left(\max_{1\leq  k \leq  n}(\lvert S_{k}-\mathbb{E}S_{k} \rvert )\geq  \lambda\right)\leq  \frac{\text{Var}(S_{n})}{\lambda^2}.
$$

:::

`\begin{proof}`
Applying [[doob-kolmogorov-inequality]] to the martingale
$S_{n}-\mathbb{E}S_{n}$ we have
$$
\mathbb{P}\left( \max_{1 \leq  k \leq  n}(\lvert S_{k}-\mathbb{E}S_{k} \rvert )\geq  \lambda \right) \leq  \frac{{\mathbb{E}\lvert S_{n}-\mathbb{E}S_{n} \rvert^2 }}{\lambda^2}= \frac{\text{Var}(S_{n})}{\lambda^2}.
$$
`\end{proof}`
